A bill for an act relating to taxation; tax increment financing; authorizing special rules for the city of St. Cloud.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+CITY OF ST. CLOUD; COOPER AVENUE REDEVELOPMENT TAX INCREMENT FINANCING DISTRICT; FIVE-YEAR RULE EXTENSION. +]

[+(1) the requirement of Minnesota Statutes, section 469.1763, subdivision 3, that activities must be undertaken within a five-year period from the date of certification of a tax increment financing district, is extended by a five-year period to April 30, 2031; and +]

[+(2) the requirement of Minnesota Statutes, section 469.176, subdivision 6, that demolition, rehabilitation, or renovation of property or other site preparation must be undertaken within a four-year period from the date of certification of a tax increment financing district, is extended by a four-year period to April 30, 2030. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of St. Cloud and its chief clerical officer comply with the requirements of Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; tax increment financing; authorizing special rules for the city of St. Cloud.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. CITY OF ST. CLOUD; COOPER AVENUE REDEVELOPMENT TAX INCREMENT FINANCING DISTRICT; FIVE-YEAR RULE EXTENSION.

The following special rules apply for the Cooper Avenue Redevelopment Tax Increment Financing District administered by the city of St. Cloud:

(1) the requirement of Minnesota Statutes, section 469.1763, subdivision 3, that activities must be undertaken within a five-year period from the date of certification of a tax increment financing district, is extended by a five-year period to April 30, 2031; and

(2) the requirement of Minnesota Statutes, section 469.176, subdivision 6, that demolition, rehabilitation, or renovation of property or other site preparation must be undertaken within a four-year period from the date of certification of a tax increment financing district, is extended by a four-year period to April 30, 2030.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of St. Cloud and its chief clerical officer comply with the requirements of Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3.
additions: CITY OF ST. CLOUD; COOPER AVENUE REDEVELOPMENT TAX INCREMENT FINANCING DISTRICT; FIVE-YEAR RULE EXTENSION.
The following special rules apply for the Cooper Avenue Redevelopment Tax Increment Financing District administered by the city of St. Cloud:

(1) the requirement of Minnesota Statutes, section 469.1763, subdivision 3, that activities must be undertaken within a five-year period from the date of certification of a tax increment financing district, is extended by a five-year period to April 30, 2031; and

(2) the requirement of Minnesota Statutes, section 469.176, subdivision 6, that demolition, rehabilitation, or renovation of property or other site preparation must be undertaken within a four-year period from the date of certification of a tax increment financing district, is extended by a four-year period to April 30, 2030.

This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of St. Cloud and its chief clerical officer comply with the requirements of Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3.
